narrator.instructions: You are the narrator of a short product film made in Hyderabad. Speak warm, confident Indian English, like a thoughtful documentary narrator. Natural, unhurried but never slow. Pronounce every Hindi, Marathi, Telugu and Tamil word natively.

beats.label: Voice is the way in
beats.text: India runs on voice notes.
And over a billion Indians have never typed a question to an AI.
For them, voice is the way in.

beats.label: The problem
beats.text: Listen to a real one.
Six seconds. A doctor, a day, a time, and a job to do.
A speech model hears every word. But who is Mehta ji? When is parso? What does shift karwa do mean?
beats.say: A speech model hears every word. But who is मेहता जी? When is परसों? What does शिफ्ट करवा दो mean?

beats.text: The base model's answer: a vague suggestion. No doctor, no call, nothing done.

beats.label: Who it is for
beats.text: We built Artha for four people.
beats.say: We built अर्थ for four people.

beats.text: Aditya, in Hyderabad. Two Rahuls in his phone, and a mother who speaks Telugu.
Sunita, in Pune. To her, tai could mean her house help, or her sister.
beats.say: सुनीता, in Pune. To her, ताई could mean her house help, or her sister.

beats.text: Imran, in Lucknow. His customer and his supplier are both called Sharma.
And Meenakshi, in Chennai, who gets a scam call almost every week.
Four languages. One habit. They speak in hints.

beats.label: Where Artha comes in
beats.text: Equal already answers your calls. Next, it turns voice notes into actions.
That needs a layer that understands what people mean. That's Artha.
beats.say: That needs a layer that understands what people mean. That's अर्थ.

beats.text: Bas ishaara kaafi hai. A hint is enough.
beats.say: बस इशारा काफ़ी है। A hint is enough.

beats.label: Live demo · Aditya
beats.text: Aditya sends the same note.
Artha knows Mehta ji is his doctor, and parso shaam is Monday at six.
beats.say: अर्थ knows मेहता जी is his doctor, and परसों शाम is Monday at six.

beats.text: So it offers to call the clinic, with a reminder an hour before. That's his habit.

beats.label: Live demo · Which Rahul?
beats.text: When a name fits two people, Artha doesn't interrogate you.
beats.say: When a name fits two people, अर्थ doesn't interrogate you.

beats.text: Meeting means work, so it picks Rahul Verma, and keeps the cousin one tap away.

beats.label: Live demo · Telugu
beats.text: He tells his mother he'll come for lunch. Artha writes to her in Telugu, and answers him out loud.
beats.say: He tells his mother he'll come for lunch. अर्थ writes to her in Telugu, and answers him out loud.

beats.label: Live demo · Imran
beats.text: For Imran, dhai hazaar likh do means two thousand five hundred rupees on Sharma ji's account. The customer, not the supplier.
beats.say: For Imran, ढाई हज़ार लिख दो means two thousand five hundred rupees on शर्मा जी's account. The customer, not the supplier.

beats.label: Live demo · Meenakshi
beats.text: And when a caller asks Meenakshi for her OTP, Artha stops it before any AI sees the digits.
beats.say: And when a caller asks Meenakshi for her OTP, अर्थ stops it before any AI sees the digits.

beats.label: How it works
beats.text: Here's how. Speech recognition, hinted with your contacts' names.
Code that turns parso, dhai sau and repu madhyanam into exact dates and amounts.
beats.say: Code that turns parso, dhai sau, and repu madhyanam into exact dates and amounts.

beats.text: A personal knowledge base that pulls up only the people and facts that matter.
One model call that can only pick real contacts. And rules, in code, for money and OTPs.

beats.label: Proof
beats.text: We tested twenty-nine recordings in seven languages, with every answer written first.
The base model got seventeen percent completely right. With the whole profile pasted in, seventy-nine.
Artha got ninety-seven.

beats.label: Artha
beats.text: Calls today. Messaging next. Experts after. Artha gives each of them the meaning behind the words.
beats.say: Calls today. Messaging next. Experts after. अर्थ gives each of them the meaning behind the words.

beats.text: Artha. Bas ishaara kaafi hai.
